TABLE: audit_events (ENGINE=InnoDB, DYNAMIC, utf8mb4_unicode_ci) -- COLUMN | DATA TYPE | NULL | STORAGE / COMPRESSION id | CHAR(36) | NO | 36 Bytes (Clustered PK) organization_id | CHAR(36) | NO | 36 Bytes (Tenant Foreign Key) sequence_number | BIGINT UNSIGNED | NO | 8 Bytes (Monotonic strictly +1) event_action | VARCHAR(100) | NO | 1-100 Bytes actor_id | VARCHAR(100) | NO | 1-100 Bytes target_id | VARCHAR(100) | NO | 1-100 Bytes payload | TEXT | NO | LOB Overflow Page (RFC 8785 JSON) record_hash | CHAR(64) | NO | 64 Bytes (Fixed SHA-256 Digest) prev_record_hash | CHAR(64) | NO | 64 Bytes (Fixed SHA-256 Digest) created_at | DATETIME(6) | NO | 8 Bytes (Microsecond UTC) -- PHYSICAL B-TREE INDEX TOPOLOGY: PRIMARY KEY (id) USING BTREE [Clustered Index] UNIQUE KEY uq_org_seq (organization_id, sequence_number) USING BTREE [Composite Cover] KEY idx_org_created (organization_id, created_at) USING BTREE [Time Range Scan] KEY idx_record_hash (record_hash) USING BTREE [Point Lookup]

TABLE: chain_heads (ENGINE=InnoDB, ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC) -- COLUMN | DATA TYPE | NULL | CONCURRENCY / LOCK SEMANTICS organization_id | CHAR(36) | NO | PK (Target for SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) head_sequence_number | BIGINT UNSIGNED | NO | 8 Bytes (Atomically Incremented) head_record_hash | CHAR(64) | NO | 64 Bytes (Latest SHA-256 Hex) genesis_hash | CHAR(64) | NO | 64 Bytes (Initial Anchor) updated_at | DATETIME(6) | NO | 8 Bytes (Microsecond Lock Release) -- PHYSICAL INDEX TOPOLOGY: PRIMARY KEY (organization_id) USING BTREE [Single Row Exclusive Inode Lock]

TABLE: checkpoints (ENGINE=InnoDB, ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC) -- COLUMN | DATA TYPE | NULL | OBJECT STORAGE METADATA id | CHAR(36) | NO | 36 Bytes PK organization_id | CHAR(36) | NO | 36 Bytes FK sequence_number | BIGINT UNSIGNED | NO | Milestone Snapshot Seq checkpoint_hash | CHAR(64) | NO | 64 Bytes SHA-256 Anchor storage_provider | VARCHAR(32) | NO | 'AWS_S3' / 'MINIO' / 'LOCAL' s3_bucket | VARCHAR(100) | NO | S3 Bucket Name s3_object_key | VARCHAR(255) | NO | Target URI Path s3_version_id | VARCHAR(100) | YES | AWS S3 Object Version ID created_at | DATETIME(6) | NO | 8 Bytes Microsecond UTC -- PHYSICAL INDEX TOPOLOGY: PRIMARY KEY (id) USING BTREE KEY idx_cp_org_seq (organization_id, sequence_number) USING BTREE

PHYSICAL STORAGE ALLOCATION & HARDENING GUIDELINES:
1. InnoDB Buffer Pool: Configured to cache uq_org_seq and chain_heads in RAM for sub-millisecond pessimistic row locks.
2. Write Volume: audit_events uses append-only pattern with sequential primary and composite index insertions to minimize page splits.
3. Out-of-Band Physical Isolation: Checkpoint files are physically replicated to AWS S3 Object Lock (WORM COMPLIANCE mode) on AWS KMS hardware modules, ensuring zero physical write access to database administrators.
